name: Kai Chen
details:
Aloha 👋! This is Kai 🌊! I'm an exchange student from China. I'm a senior majoring in Maths & Applied Maths. I did CS 61A last semester and fell in love with this course (eventually) and computer science 💻! I didn't understand the beauty of computing and did badly at first 🫨, but thanks to my tutor at that moment, I did very well in the end 🥹. I hope to help you uncover the mechanisms of python and get through the mist of recursion(dada..!🫯). And more importantly, I want to help students learn how to keep track of their own study progress ✅, build their confidence for coding and even inspire them to seek more beauty of computer science in the future 🌟!
In my personal time, I like reading 📚 and listening to music 🎶. I always play some music when I get the chance to, and music makes my life much more colorful 🌈. Life would be boring if we didn't have music! And my favorite band is Hitsujibungaku 🐑 always~

Today, I also help organize a number of science competitions, including Berkeley Science Bowl, Berkeley Chemistry Tournament (through Berkeley ACS), and several high school Science Bowl invitationals across the country. Outside of academics, I play trombone in the UC Berkeley Philharmonia and occasionally pick up my other instrument, euphonium, when I get the time. While my background is rooted in chemistry, I thoroughly enjoyed CS70, both for the content and as a class at Berkeley, and I'm excited to help teach it this year!
